findings.summary: The owl's 'happy' face is pixel-identical to her 'blink' face. The cat's 'happy' face differs from 'asleep' only by a mouth 30% wider. The shared painter draws 'archHappy' and 'closedHappy' as the same stroke. Once tracks A and C wire these faces as the plan says, three things go wrong. The owl rests on 'happy' while she speaks (Step 6), so she talks, and reads a whole story, with her eyes shut, and her blink cannot be seen while she talks. The cat's 'goes happy' when petted (Step 13) shows no visible change. The planned OWL and CAT clauses read face names or map objects, so they would still pass. Two of the 10 canvases in the texture budget are duplicates. PAINTED FACES cannot see any of this.
findings.evidence: I rendered every face canvas and each head in headless Chromium, through playwright-core, at bb4eb46f. The command was `SERVED_CHECKS_PORT=6379 pnpm run with-dev-server node shoot-faces.mjs`, and the page imported libraryFaces.ts and libraryCreatures.ts with page.evaluate. Output of shasum on the images: owl-blink.png and owl-happy.png are both 34fea1461a7465159fe3d5f116597e83313d65c3. owl-blink-3d.png and owl-happy-3d.png are both da58cd499a3db6f256c0ec7628ea79c5498a001b. The cause is src/art/style/faces.ts:141, `const up = o.eyeStyle === 'archHappy' ? 1 : 1;`, so closedHappy and archHappy draw the same arc. In libraryFaces.ts, lines 119-120 make the owl's blink and happy differ only in eyeStyle, and her mouth is 'none'. Lines 172-173 make the cat's asleep and happy differ only in mouthW (0.049 vs 0.07). cat-asleep-3d.png and cat-happy-3d.png show the same closed ∩ ∩ eyes; only the 'w' mouth is a few pixels wider. The plan's Step 6 sets the resting face to `speaking ? 'happy'`, and Step 13 has petting go to 'happy' and then back to 'asleep'.
findings.fix: In libraryFaces.ts (Step 3 owns it), give each named face paint that changes pixels. The owl's happy could keep open eyes and add a blush (ART.blush), so she looks at the child while she talks and her blink stays the closed arc. The cat's happy could have open eyes (she wakes and looks up), or archHappy with bigSmile and a blush. Add this to 'For the join' for tracks A and C before they wire setFace or createFaceLife. Leave the park-wide no-op in faces.ts alone, or fix it in its own change.
